patch_description: Replace the seed ansatz (RY+RZ_pre+linear_CZ+RZ_post = 24 params/block) with a more compact brick-layer ring CZ design (RY+even_CZ+RZ+odd_CZ = 16 params/block). This reduces total parameters from 146 to 98 while improving entanglement connectivity by closing the qubit ring (7→0 connection). The brick-layer structure also enables parallel CZ execution, reducing depth. With 6 blocks total (3 uploads × 2 repeats), ring connectivity ensures all qubits can communicate within 2 blocks. RY+RZ provides full single-qubit rotation coverage, and the CZ ring provides complete pairwise entanglement.
